fluff.overview: Federated Suns infantry benefit from one of the strongest industrial bases in the Inner Sphere, with AFFS quartermasters able to supply platoons with standardized equipment and ammunition from a logistics network that few rival states can match. Mechanized tracked platoons ride armored personnel carriers that provide both protection and all-terrain mobility, allowing these troops to keep pace with armored advances across open ground and survive the indirect fire that scatters lighter formations. These anti-aircraft specialists are trained and equipped to engage low-flying aerospace fighters, VTOLs, and conventional aircraft, providing dedicated point air defense for installations and ground formations.
